source.title: Layout
source.description: `Layout` class splitting the terminal into nested `name`-addressable regions via `split_column`/`split_row`, each set with `update`; size by fixed `size` or flexible `ratio`/`minimum_size`, toggle `visible`, pair with `Live` for fullscreen apps.

source.title: Panel
source.description: `rich.panel.Panel` draws a border around any renderable; the `box` argument picks the style, `expand=False` or `Panel.fit()` shrinks it to content, and `title`/`subtitle` label the top and bottom edges.
